subject.title: [Feature]: add VALUE.md as a first-class workspace context file

question: Should VALUE.md become a core first-class bootstrap/context file with default seeding and workspace-file priority semantics, or should value guidance stay in existing files or an opt-in configurable bootstrap-file API?
rationale: This changes OpenClaw prompt semantics and default workspace surface, and the direct implementation was already closed as broad product/design work rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Prefer Configurable Context Files
options.body: Resolve the broader arbitrary bootstrap-file API and let users opt into VALUE.md without adding a new hardcoded core semantic file.

options.title: Accept First-Class VALUE.md
options.body: Sponsor a fresh focused PR that adds VALUE.md everywhere existing first-class bootstrap files are recognized and documents its precedence clearly.

options.title: Keep Existing Files Only
options.body: Decline the new surface and document that value orientation belongs in SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, USER.md, or MEMORY.md depending on lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Prefer Configurable Context Files
recommendation.body: Resolve the broader arbitrary bootstrap-file API and let users opt into VALUE.md without adding a new hardcoded core semantic file.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the maintainer-facing product/design rationale when closing the direct VALUE.md implementation PR and has recent current-line ownership in the workspace path.
